name: Samse SA
summary: Samse SA engages in the trading of construction materials in France. The company offers construction materials, structural work, plaster, ceiling, insulation, framing, roofing, wood, panels, doors, windows, joinery, floor and wall coverings, terrace, garden, public works, roads, sanitation, tools, equipment, hardware, safety, electricity, plumbing, sanitary ware, and heating products. It is also involved in the distribution of materials for building and public works, as well as DIY, gardening, and indoor equipment items. The company was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Grenoble, France. Samse SA operates as a subsidiary of Dumont Investissement.
